_comment: Portable deny-list snippet for the stay-in-project-tree module. Paste these entries into the `permissions.deny` array of a host repo's .claude/settings.json. Path anchors matter: in Read/Edit/Write rules Claude Code reads `//path` as filesystem-absolute, `~/path` as home-relative (resolves per machine, no username needed), and a single leading `/path` as relative to the settings source (the project, for project settings), so `Read(/etc/**)` would deny `<repo>/etc/**` and block nothing. Keep system directories on `//` and credential stores on `~/`. The snippet covers system directories, credential stores, shell rc files, and the global Claude config; it intentionally does NOT block /tmp (some tools legitimately write there) or the per-project ~/.claude/projects/<hash>/ dir (Claude Code scopes that to this project by design). See the companion index.md for the prose rule.
